subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode diagnosis until live current-main envelopes identify the drop boundary, or fold it into a broader Slack Socket Mode issue now?
rationale: Current source proves handler support and plausible filter boundaries, but the remaining failure depends on live Slack delivery evidence that automation cannot infer from mocked handler tests.

options.title: Keep reaction-specific diagnosis

options.title: Merge into broader Socket Mode tracking
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 as the canonical path if maintainers decide reaction loss is just one symptom of the broader Socket Mode failure class.

options.title: Reopen prior routing fix scope

recommendation.title: Keep reaction-specific diagnosis
